# Variable `EXTRA_AUTORECONF`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

For recipes inheriting the autotools* class, you can use EXTRA_AUTORECONF to specify extra options to pass to the `autoreconf` command that is executed during the do_configure task.

The default value is “–exclude=autopoint”.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-EXTRA_AUTORECONF)
